name: Exam Prep
description: At Collab, we provide students with exam preparation courses in order to cover for insufficiencies during the application process so the students can overcome the obstacles along the way of their admission process. Since each school has its own admission requirements, students are expected to have certain grades and scores from a variety of exams. These exams can be English proficiency exams, entrance exams or exams that are made obligatory by the government.
